name: North Carolina

default_limits.basis: G.S. 20-141(b): 35 inside municipal corporate limits, 55 outside (all classes). Mapping assumes residential streets are in town; any road inside city limits defaults to 35. Up to 70 only where DOT posts (20-141(d)).

fine.notes: Chief judges' waiver (prepay) fines, plus costs. 16+ over is waivable ($50) only if speed was 55 or under; above that, judge sets fine (Class 3 misd., max $200). Infraction max $100 (20-176(b)).

court_costs.notes: AOC chart eff. 12/1/2020: $191 Ch. 20 infraction, $193 Ch. 20 misdemeanor. Newer chart not checked; may have risen.

points.notes: Based on actual speed, not mph over: 3 pts if over 55 mph; 2 pts ('other moving violation') if 55 or under; school zone 3. 12 pts in 3 yrs = suspension (20-16). Insurance points separate.

zones.work_zone: $250 extra penalty when work-zone penalty signs posted (20-141(j2)).
zones.school_zone: $250 penalty on school property (20-141(e1)); waiver list: $250 + costs; 3 pts.

court.reason: Criminal speeding; not prepayable if over 55 mph. 30-day license suspension if 16+ over AND over 55, or over 80 (20-16.1).

arrest.offense: Speeding more than 15 over or over 80 mph (Class 3 misdemeanor)
arrest.license: 30-day suspension if 16+ over and over 55 mph, or over 80 (20-16.1(a)); 60 days if 2nd within 1 yr

trucks.notes: 20-141(b) limits apply to all vehicles (school buses excepted). Oversize permit loads 15+ over = Class 2 misd. (20-141(j3)).

sources.title: 2025 HB 112 (75 mph bill, not enacted per text seen)

notes: Criminal = more than 15 over OR over 80 mph. First offender with 3 or fewer priors: fine only, no jail (15A-1340.23(d)); up to 20 days with more priors. Waiver list and costs chart may be outdated (latest found 2019/2020). 2025 HB 112 (75 mph interstates) showed no action past committee. DA reductions common.
